Recommended design: compare SASRec and its uniform-history, last-item, and learned exponential-history residual variants with identical splits, routing, preprocessing seed=0, training seed=42, and evaluator seed=42. Copy shared initial weights explicitly; equal seeds alone cannot guarantee matched initialization after architecture changes. Match minibatch order and training negatives using independent random streams. Hold backbone, loss, optimizer, history length, residual normalization/gating, and training allowance constant for the architectural ablation. Evaluate the same 200 users/category and 99 unique negatives/user; report all four HR@10 values and their equal-weight macro average. Fixed candidates improve pairing, but sampled rankings need not preserve full-catalog model ordering ([Krichene–Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)).

Prespecify checkpoint evaluation frequency, maximum epochs, patience, and tie-breaking; select by the common macro validation HR@10, using the same rule for every variant. Separately tuned comparisons need equal search allowances. For uncertainty, retain each user’s paired hit indicators; bootstrap 200 users with replacement within each category, using identical resampled indices across models, then average the four category differences. Report paired 95% intervals and discordant-hit counts ([paired resampling](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html)). These intervals condition on checkpoints, training seed, candidates, and observed categories; they omit training variability, candidate uncertainty, cross-category generalization, and adaptive selection bias. Sparse disagreements can make intervals unstable.

Preregister variants and search ranges; cap trials and validation queries, reserve compute for completing all comparisons, and charge training, diagnostics, debugging, and failures against 43,200 GPU-seconds across concurrent slots. Log every attempt. Repeated checkpoint and hyperparameter selection can overfit validation; bootstrap intervals do not repair this. Freeze the selected procedure before the host’s final held-out evaluation; treat validation gains as exploratory ([Cawley–Talbot](https://www.jmlr.org/papers/v11/cawley10a.html), [Dwork et al.](https://papers.nips.cc/paper_files/paper/2015/hash/bad5f33780c42f2588878a9d07405083-Abstract.html)).
